requirements.quote: ATOMIC_AGGREGATE is a well-known discretionary attribute.
requirements.condition: When classifying the ATOMIC_AGGREGATE path attribute
requirements.required_behavior: Treat ATOMIC_AGGREGATE as a well-known discretionary attribute.
requirements.why_checkable: Attribute recognition and category handling are concrete implementation properties.

requirements.quote:
When a BGP speaker aggregates several routes for the purpose of
   advertisement to a particular peer, the AS_PATH of the aggregated
   route normally includes an AS_SET formed from the set of ASes from
   which the aggregate was formed.  In many cases, the network
   administrator can determine if the aggregate can safely be advertised
   without the AS_SET, and without forming route loops.
requirements.condition: When aggregating several routes for advertisement to a particular peer
requirements.required_behavior: Normally include in the aggregate AS_PATH an AS_SET formed from the ASes of the constituent routes; the network administrator can determine whether omission is safe without forming route loops.
requirements.why_checkable: The aggregate AS_PATH construction and configured omission behavior can be checked against constituent AS paths.

requirements.quote:
If an aggregate excludes at least some of the AS numbers present in
   the AS_PATH of the routes that are aggregated as a result of dropping
   the AS_SET, the aggregated route, when advertised to the peer, SHOULD
   include the ATOMIC_AGGREGATE attribute.
requirements.condition: When dropping AS_SET causes an aggregate to exclude at least some AS numbers present in the constituent routes AS_PATHs, and advertising that aggregate to a peer
requirements.why_checkable: Aggregation output can be checked for the attribute when AS numbers are omitted.

requirements.quote:
A BGP speaker that receives a route with the ATOMIC_AGGREGATE
   attribute SHOULD NOT remove the attribute when propagating the route
   to other speakers.
requirements.condition: When propagating to other speakers a received route carrying ATOMIC_AGGREGATE
requirements.forbidden_behavior: SHOULD NOT remove the ATOMIC_AGGREGATE attribute.
requirements.why_checkable: Propagation of a received attribute can be inspected and checked in advertised routes.

requirements.quote:
A BGP speaker that receives a route with the ATOMIC_AGGREGATE
   attribute MUST NOT make any NLRI of that route more specific (as
   defined in 9.1.4) when advertising this route to other BGP speakers.
requirements.condition: When advertising to other BGP speakers a received route carrying ATOMIC_AGGREGATE
requirements.forbidden_behavior: MUST NOT make any NLRI of that route more specific, as defined in Section 9.1.4.
requirements.why_checkable: Received and advertised NLRI specificity can be compared.
